samples.xml_description:
<module id="freq_diveven">
    <description>Frequency divider that divides the input clock frequency by even numbers. This module generates a divided clock signal by toggling its output every specified number of input clock cycles.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Input clock signal that will be divided.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Active-low reset signal to initialize the module.</input>
        <output id="clk_div">Divided clock output signal.</output>
    </ports>
    
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="NUM_DIV" value="4'd2">Division factor for the frequency divider, must be an even number greater than 2.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    
    <implementation> 
    Always block triggered on the rising edge of the input clock or the active-low reset signal.
    Counter to keep track of the current count of clock cycles.
    Toggled divided clock signal whenever the counter reaches NUM_DIV/2 - 1.
    </implementation>
</module>
